(Published by Authority) PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices

No. 1907/51 – FRIDAY, MARCH 27, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7
I, hereby give notice, under sub-Section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands which are required for a public purpose.

Description of the Land to be acquired: Allotments of land in extent of about 0.0583 Hectare, depicted as Lot Number, 85 to 99 in block No. 11 of Cadastral Map No. 520802 prepared by the Surveyor-General, situated in Dutugemunu village in Dehiwela Divisional Secretary’s Division, in Colombo District in Western Province and bounded as follows:—

01. Lot No. 85 Name of the Land: Etambagahwatta, Assmt. No. 28, Sunethra Devi Road; Description: Garden; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Gurunnanselage Don Bandula Amarasiri, No. 24, Sunethra Devi Road, Kohuwala; Extent: 0.0117 Hectare.

02. Lot No. 87 Name of the Land: Delgahawatta, Assmt. No. 28, Sunethra Devi Road; Description: Garden, contains a part of permanent building; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Mercantile Investment Ltd, No. 28, Sunethra Devi Road, Kohuwala; Extent: 0.0151 Hectare.
03. Lot No. 89 Name of the Land: —; Entrance;Description: Road; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Not found; Extent: 0.0027 Hectare.

04. Lot No. 91 Name of the Land: Assmt. No. 30, Sunethra Devi Road; Description: Garden; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Mercantile Investment Ltd, No. 30, Sunethra Devi Road, Kohuwala; Extent: 0.0063 Hectare.

05. Lot No. 93 Name of the Land: Delgahawatta, Assmt. No. 32, Sunethra Devi Road; Description: Garden, contains a part of permanent building; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Cassim Fathima Sulfika, No. 32, Sunethra Devi Road, Kohuwala; Extent: 0.0046 Hectare.

06. Lot No. 95 Name of the Land: Delgahawatta, Assmt. No. 34, Sunethra Devi Road; Description: Garden, contains a part of permanent building; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Fathima Farshana Jabir, No. 34, Sunethra Devi Road, Kohuwala; Extent: 0.0032 Hectare.
07. Lot No. 97 Name of the Land: Etambagahawatta, Not found; Description: Garden ; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Sunethra Ranasingha, Address not found; Extent: 0.0073 Hectare.
08. Lot No. 99 Name of the Land: Assmt. No. 38/A, Sunethra Devi Road; Description: Garden ; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: not found; Extent: 0.0074 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid lands are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat , Dehiwala on the 13th day of May 2015 at

9.30 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before 06th May,2015, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
K. CHAMPA N. PERERA, Divisional Secretary, Dehiwela.
Divisional Secretariat, Dehiwela. 11th March, 2015.
